Let coefficients on the original vertices be \(a_i\), and coefficients on edge-vertices be \(b_{ij}=b_{\{i,j\}}\). Put
\[
A=\sum_i a_i,\qquad B=\sum_{i<j}b_{ij},\qquad s_i=\sum_{j\ne i}b_{ij}.
\]
The zero-sum condition is \(A+B=0\).

For \(p=1\), the distances are:
\[
d(i,j)=2,\quad d(i,uv)=
\begin{cases}
1,&i\in uv,\\
3,&i\notin uv,
\end{cases}
\]
and between edge-vertices the distance is \(2\) if the two edges meet and \(4\) if they are disjoint.

Let
\[
Q=\sum_{x,y}c_xc_y d(x,y).
\]
The point-point contribution is
\[
2\sum_{i\ne j}a_ia_j=2(A^2-\sum_i a_i^2).
\]
The point-edge contribution, counting both orders, is
\[
2\sum_i a_i\bigl(s_i+3(B-s_i)\bigr)
=6AB-4\sum_i a_is_i.
\]
For the edge-edge part, let \(T\) be the ordered sum of \(b_eb_f\) over distinct edge-vertices sharing an endpoint. Then
\[
\sum_i s_i^2=2\sum_{i<j}b_{ij}^2+T,
\]
so the edge-edge contribution is
\[
4(B^2-\sum b_{ij}^2)-2T=4B^2-2\sum_i s_i^2.
\]
Therefore
\[
Q=2A^2+6AB+4B^2-2\sum_i a_i^2-4\sum_i a_is_i-2\sum_i s_i^2.
\]
Since \(A+B=0\), the scalar term vanishes:
\[
2A^2+6AB+4B^2=2(A+B)(A+2B)=0.
\]
Thus
\[
Q=-2\sum_i(a_i+s_i)^2\le 0.
\]
So \((\Gamma_n,d)\) has \(1\)-negative type.

Now show no \(p>1\) works. Use coefficients supported only on four edge-vertices:
\[
b_{12}=1,\quad b_{34}=1,\quad b_{13}=-1,\quad b_{24}=-1,
\]
all other coefficients zero. The total sum is \(0\). The only nonzero unordered cross terms give
\[
2\bigl(2\cdot 4^p-4\cdot 2^p\bigr)
=4\cdot 4^p-8\cdot 2^p
=4\cdot 2^p(2^p-2)>0
\]
for \(p>1\). Hence \(p>1\) is impossible, so
\[
\wp=1.
\]

At \(p=1\), equality means
\[
a_i+s_i=0\quad\text{for every }i.
\]
Summing gives \(A+2B=0\), while the zero-sum condition gives \(A+B=0\), hence \(B=0\). Conversely, any edge coefficients \(b_{ij}\) with \(B=0\), together with
\[
a_i=-s_i=-\sum_{j\ne i}b_{ij},
\]
give equality. Thus \(E\) is parametrized by all edge coefficient families with total sum zero. Since there are \(\binom n2\) edge-vertices,
\[
\dim E=\binom n2-1=\frac{n(n-1)}2-1.
\]

\[
\boxed{\left(1,\frac{n(n-1)}2-1\right)}
\]
